name: ATC_METERING_RULES
description: store details of metering rule associated with usage specification

columns.name: METERING_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique rowid of the metering rule

columns.name: METERING_RULE_PUID
columns.description: Indicates identifier of the metering rule

columns.name: METERING_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Indicates name of the metering name

columns.name: METERING_RULE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Indicates the description of the metering rule

columns.name: ROUNDING_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Type of rounding method required

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Indicates the unit of measure

columns.name: METERING_EXPR_CODE
columns.description: the whole metering rule expression in a string to help the get operation

columns.name: USAGE_SPEC_ID
columns.description: association with usage specification

columns.name: START_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Start time from which the metering rule is valid for the usage spec

columns.name: END_DATE_TIME
columns.description: End Time to  which the metering rule is valid for the usage spec

columns.name: AT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the (class) of metering rule

columns.name: AT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the base (class) of metering rule

columns.name: AT_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates a url which points to a schema which allow specifying user-defined properties of an Entity or to specify the expected characteristics of an entity

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag which indicates the the rule is active or not

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates to which top level entity this refering to

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRIGGER_CONDITION_OP_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operator used in alteration trigger condition.

columns.name: TRIGGER_CONDITION_VALUE
columns.description: Indicates the  value used in alteration trigger condition.
